This site publishes short, one-off analyses that support the development of [OpenPrescribing Hospitals](https://hospitals.openprescribing.net/). It is a public notebook for exploratory questions, methods, and findings.

Each item in the list below is a standalone report answering a specific question. Open a report to read more about the question, methods, findings, and conclusions. The code for each report is available in the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/bennettoxford/openprescribing-hospitals-explore).
